flags: feature conc_a: SENTINEL_SPIKE value -999 on 0.030 of rows (2545736x the column median)
feature conc_b: SENTINEL_SPIKE value 0 on 0.030 of rows (0x the column median)

what_it_targets.targets: a value that recurs on at least 2 percent of rows, lies outside the range of the remaining values, and is more than 100 times off-scale relative to the column median
what_it_targets.does_not_target: a sentinel in the middle of a distribution, such as a missing value filled with the mean, which is numerically indistinguishable from a real value
what_it_targets.the_third_condition: is what protects a legitimately capped feature, which sits at a few times the median rather than a hundred
what_it_targets.an_earlier_version_that_failed: an absolute-gap version missed a zero fill among log-normal concentrations, because the fill sits only micro-units below the minimum

status_of_the_tool: with this, the known blind spots recorded since R149 are closed and feature_audit is in a handover-able state
limits: The 2 percent and hundredfold thresholds are chosen, not optimised.
Only extreme-value sentinels are covered; mid-distribution ones are not detectable in principle.
Retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim.

the_first_attempt_failed_and_that_is_the.first_rule: a sentinel is a repeated value outside the rest's range, farther from it than half the range
the_first_attempt_failed_and_that_is_the.what_it_missed: a zero fill among log-normal concentrations, because zero sits only micro-units below the minimum in absolute terms, even though it is plainly a filled-in placeholder
the_first_attempt_failed_and_that_is_the.fix: compare against the column's own median instead: a sentinel is off-scale by more than a hundredfold
the_first_attempt_failed_and_that_is_the.why_the_fix_works: a zero fill has ratio 0 and a -999 fill has ratio 2.5 million, while a legitimate cap sits at a few times the median
the_first_attempt_failed_and_that_is_the.note: this is the fourth time in this tool line that a rule looked sensible and failed on contact with real-shaped data

feature_level: unseen codes, restricted to genuine multi-level code columns
values outside the vocabulary of an indicator column
one level dominating on evaluation but not in training
the_tool_is_now_handoverable.whitelist: expected_uninformative, confined to feature-level flags on named columns
the_tool_is_now_handoverable.not_targeted_by_design: a sentinel in the middle of a distribution, such as a missing value filled with the mean, is numerically indistinguishable from a real value

what_remains_untested.note: every rule in this tool was derived from a failure rather than from theory, so the tool is best understood as a catalogue of the mistakes made in this programme
what_remains_untested.consequence: it is well suited to catching those mistakes again and poorly suited to catching mistakes nobody here has made yet
